Part 1 (Interview: 3–4 minutes)

0:03 Examiner: Good afternoon. Can I have your mark sheets, please?
0:08 Examiner: Thank you.
0:10 Examiner: I'm John Davey and this is Gillian Crossen. And what's your name?
0:14 Debora: My name is Debora.
0:16 Examiner: Debora.
0:17 Inma: And my name is Inma.
0:18 Examiner: Inma, thank you. Inma, do you work or are you a student?
0:24 Inma: Well, I'm doing both at the same time. I'm working at the same time and studying online, so…
0:30 Examiner: OK. And where do you come from?
0:32 Inma: Spain.
0:33 Examiner: Spain, thank you. Debora, do you work or are you a student?
0:37 Debora: I'm working.
0:38 Examiner: And where do you come from?
0:40 Debora: I'm from Spain.
0:42 Examiner: Thank you. Now, let's talk about the area where you live. Debora, what do you like doing outdoors in your area?
0:50 Debora: Well, I'm from the Canary Islands. It's a mountain island, it's amazing. You can go for hiking, trekking… you can visit many places, it's really nice. And if you like, you can go to visit the beach, you can do surfing, snorkel…
1:09 Examiner: And how do you travel in the area where you live?
1:12 Debora: By car. It's cheap.
1:15 Examiner: Thank you. And Inma, what's the best place to go in the evening in your area?
1:20 Inma: Well, in my area… actually I'm living in a small town, so it doesn't have too many things to do during the night, because it's quite small. But we have a really close town, just close to mine, so…
1:35 Examiner: What is the traffic like where you live?
1:37 Inma: It's not too bad. By car you can go everywhere, of course, and it's taking you just five, ten minutes, not more.
1:45 Examiner: Thank you. And Debora, please tell me something about the people who live near you.
1:51 Debora: In the Canary Islands the people are really lovely. They are so friendly, and they can help you if you don't understand Spanish. This is really nice.
2:01 Examiner: Thank you. Now, let's talk about clothes. Inma, what kind of clothes do you wear when you do sport?
2:09 Inma: Well, just… I'm trying to wear something comfy that lets me move myself, like, quite easy.
2:17 Examiner: And who do you go shopping for clothes with?
2:20 Inma: Well, my housemate, actually. He really likes sports, so we used to go to buy some clothes together.
2:28 Examiner: OK. And Debora, where do you buy your clothes?
2:31 Debora: Normally I love buying in Zara. I love the clothes by Zara.
2:37 Examiner: And what clothes do you wear when you're at home?
2:40 Debora: Pyjamas.
2:44 Examiner: And Inma, please tell me something about the clothes you wear when you go to parties.
2:50 Inma: To be honest, I'm always using, like, simple clothes. I don't like too many colours at the same time or something like that, so I'm always wearing black things, simple… trainers.

Part 2 (Collaborative task and discussion: 5–6 minutes)

3:05 Examiner: Now, in this part of the test you're going to talk together. Here are some pictures that show different types of food. Do you like these types of food? Say why or why not. I'll say that again: do you like these different types of food? Say why or why not. All right? Now, talk together.
3:33 Debora: OK, Inma. I love the desserts, because for me it's my favourite food in the whole world. I love cake, chocolate, all type of dessert. What do you like? What type of food do you like?
3:52 Inma: Well… I don't like too much the desserts, to be honest, because they are just too sweet, and I don't like the really, really sweet things. So… but from here I can say maybe my favourite one could be fruit, or also vegetables. What do you think about fruit and vegetables?
4:26 Debora: Well, I don't like too much fruit, and I don't like too much vegetables. But I know I need to eat, because it's healthy. It's the most healthy food we have.
4:46 Debora: Now, Inma, what do you think about the fast food?
4:51 Inma: Well, I don't like too much the fast food neither, because it just makes me feel so heavy. So no, it's just not for me.
5:02 Examiner: Thank you. Inma, do you think fruit is healthy?
5:07 Inma: Yeah, of course. I think so. It hasn't anything from outside, like chemicals or something like that, so yeah, I think it's healthy.
5:19 Examiner: OK. And what about you, what do you think, Debora?
5:26 Debora: I think it's really good for your body, but today it is more expensive than the fast food.
5:34 Examiner: Well, do you think fast food is expensive?
5:39 Debora: Well, no. I think fast food is cheap, is really cheap compared with the fruit today. What do you think, Inma, if the fast food is expensive?
5:53 Inma: Well, it depends on the place you are buying fast food. Because if you are going, for example, I don't know, to some really cheap restaurant, you can have it like a proper meal, not too expensive. But if you are going to another kind of restaurants… yeah.
6:12 Examiner: Do you think cake is nice?
6:16 Inma: Well… it depends. If it has too many things, like too many different chocolates or too many different sweet things, no, I don't really like.
6:30 Examiner: And Debora, do you think vegetables are boring?
6:34 Debora: Sorry, can you repeat?
6:35 Examiner: Do you think vegetables are boring?
6:39 Debora: Um, I think no. I think the vegetables help you a lot, because it's really healthy.
6:49 Examiner: Do you think pizza is popular?
6:51 Debora: I think it's the most popular today. You can eat in many places. What about you, Inma? If you think the pizza is popular?
7:00 Inma: Yes, I think so as well, because in every place you can find pizza. Also if it is not the speciality of that place, but yeah, you can always have pizza.
7:13 Examiner: And Debora, which of these types of food do you like best?
7:21 Debora: Well, I love pizza and burger, but for me, I think the cakes.
7:29 Examiner: Thank you. And Inma, which of these types of food do you like best?
7:35 Inma: I think if I have to choose one, I will choose fruit, because I really like all kind of fruit. So yeah, in summer they are perfect.
7:47 Examiner: Thank you.
7:52 Examiner: Now, do you prefer having a large meal or just a snack at lunchtime, Inma?
7:58 Inma: Well… I don't have too much time for lunch, so I think I prefer to have just a snack.
8:06 Examiner: And what about you, Debora?
8:08 Debora: For me, I prefer a large meal, because I don't know when I will go to have time for it again.
8:15 Examiner: Do you prefer eating inside or outside, Debora?
8:19 Debora: Well, for me I prefer eat outside, because for that you can try different type of food. I know that you will go to spend a lot of money, but it's nice, try different food.
8:32 Examiner: And what about you, Inma?
8:34 Inma: If I prefer to eat at home or outside?
8:36 Examiner: Well, inside or outside.
8:38 Inma: OK. Um, I prefer to eat at home, because I'm quite special with the food. I don't like too many things, so I prefer to cook in my house.
8:50 Examiner: Thank you. That's the end of the test.
8:52 Inma: Thank you.
